source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 8.1 with Figs. 8.1 to 8.3 (PDF 174-176).

blocks.text: Yeh chapter physics ke do bare hisson par baat karta hai: transverse waves ki polarization aur gravitational waves. Hum in dono ko ek ek kar ke parhenge.
Polarization ke hawale se physical optics yeh dekhti hai ke light waves kaise behave karti hain aur matter (maadda) ke saath un ka kya interaction (taalluq) hota hai.

blocks.alt: Do taar, har ek neeche baen sire par haath mein pakri hui aur tirchhi daen oopar jati hui. Oopar wale taar (a) par wave (lehar) oopar neeche hai, saath khara dohra teer; neeche wale taar (b) par wave horizontal (ufuqi) surface mein daen baen hai, saath para dohra teer.
blocks.caption: Figure 8.1: Taar par transverse waves, (a) perpendicular (90° par) (vertical) surface mein aur (b) horizontal surface mein polarized (kitab ki Figure 8.1 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Interference aur diffraction sabit karte hain ke light ek wave hai. Lekin in se yeh pata nahi chalta ke light waves longitudinal hain ya transverse. Polarization se pata chalta hai ke light waves transverse hain (un ki vibration chalne ki direction (simt) ke perpendicular hoti hai).

Transverse mechanical waves mein, jaise khinchi hui rassi (string) par banne wali waves, medium ke particles ki vibration wave ke aage barhne (propagation) ki direction ke perpendicular hoti hai. Yeh vibration vertical (oopar-neeche), horizontal (daen-baen) ya kisi aur direction mein ho sakti hai (Fig. 8.1). In mein se har case mein wave polarized kehlati hai. Plane of polarization woh plane (seedhi satah) hai jis mein particles ki vibration ki direction aur wave ke aage barhne ki direction dono hon.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Dono rassiyon par wave rassi ke perpendicular hilti hai, isi liye yeh transverse hai. (a) mein particles sirf oopar-neeche hilte hain, to plane of polarization vertical hai; (b) mein sirf daen-baen, to plane horizontal hai. Jis wave ki vibration ek hi plane mein rahe woh polarized kehlati hai.

Oscillating (jhoolte) charge se banne wali light wave mein electric field vector E baar baar (periodically) badalta hai, aur us ke saath magnetic field vector B hota hai; E aur B ek doosre se 90° par hain. Aam light mein vibration har mumkin plane mein hoti hai; aisi light unpolarized kehlati hai. Agar vibration sirf ek plane tak confined (mehdood) ho to light polarized kehlati hai. Unpolarized light Fig. 8.2 mein dikhayi gayi hai.

blocks.alt: Neeche baen jalta hua incandescent bulb. Bulb se ek lakeer oopar ek nuqte tak jati hai jahan se peele teer har direction mein bahar ki taraf hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 8.2: Incandescent bulb ki unpolarized light ki vibrations har direction mein hoti hain (kitab ki Figure 8.2 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Unpolarized light ki misalein: dhoop (sunlight), incandescent (filament wale) bulb, fluorescent bulb, mom batti ya aag ki light (roshni).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Peele teer electric field E ki vibration ki directions (simt) hain. Bulb ki light mein E har direction mein hilta hai; koi ek direction khaas nahi. Isi ko unpolarized light kehte hain.

Polarization woh process (amal) hai jis se light waves ki electric aur magnetic vibrations ko sirf ek plane tak confine kar diya jata hai. Yeh property (khoobi) sirf transverse waves, jaise light, mein hoti hai. Longitudinal waves, jaise sound, mein polarization nahi hoti (un ki vibration chalne ki direction ke saath hi hoti hai, is liye koi plane chunne ka sawal nahi).
